Beauty & Glow Infusion

from £179

  • Ingredients
  • Prices

The Beauty & Glow Infusion is designed to support healthy skin from within. It pairs high-dose vitamin C with glutathione, two antioxidants that work closely together in the body. Vitamin C contributes to normal collagen formation for the normal function of the skin. Collagen is the protein that gives skin its structure and firmness. Vitamin C also contributes to the protection of cells from oxidative stress, which is driven by factors such as UV exposure and pollution. Glutathione is one of the skin's key antioxidants and helps protect skin cells from this same oxidative stress. It also recycles vitamin C back into its active form so it can continue working. In clinical studies glutathione has been shown to act on the enzyme that controls pigmentation, shifting the skin towards a brighter tone. This is why it is widely associated with a radiant and more even complexion. Delivered in a litre of electrolyte-rich solution, the infusion also supports hydration. It is a popular choice before an event or as part of a regular skincare routine. The infusion is available in two glutathione strengths. The 1200mg dose is a great introduction to glutathione, while the full 2400mg dose is our ultimate skin treatment for those who want the most intensive formulation.

Ingredients

  • Electrolyte-Rich Solution (1 litre)

    Electrolyte-Rich Solution

    A balanced solution whose sodium, potassium, calcium, chloride and lactate content closely reflects that of blood plasma. It replenishes the electrolytes the body relies on for nerve signalling, muscle contraction and fluid balance.

    • Sodium Chloride (242mmol)
    • Potassium (5mmol)
    • Calcium (2mmol)
    • Bicarbonate (29mmol)
  • Vitamin C (7500mg)

    Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)

    A water-soluble antioxidant that humans cannot produce and must obtain from their diet. It is needed by the enzymes that build and stabilise collagen, the main structural protein in skin and blood vessels. It neutralises free radicals and is found in high concentrations in white blood cells. It contributes to the normal function of the immune system, normal collagen formation for the normal function of the skin, the protection of cells from oxidative stress and the reduction of tiredness and fatigue. Intravenous delivery bypasses the limits of gut absorption and achieves blood levels many times higher than oral supplements.

  • Glutathione (dose below)

    Glutathione

    Glutathione is often described as the body's most powerful antioxidant. It is made naturally from three amino acids: glutamic acid, cysteine and glycine. Most of it is produced in the liver, although almost every cell in the body makes its own supply. It neutralises free radicals, the unstable molecules that damage cells. Because oxidative stress is closely linked to inflammation, glutathione also helps regulate the body's inflammatory response. For the skin it protects cells from the oxidative stress caused by UV exposure and pollution, and it acts on the enzyme that controls pigmentation, which contributes to a brighter and more even complexion. Levels decline with age and can be depleted by alcohol, illness and oxidative stress. An infusion delivers glutathione directly into the bloodstream to boost your levels. Its effects have made it one of the most popular ingredients in the health, wellness and beauty industry.
